rationale: Held working text (re-hashed 651c64af..., OCR, 'EXICUTITI ORDER, February 19, 1900', signed William McKinley) is a single paragraph: Tutuila and all Samoan islands east of 171 W placed under control of the Department of the Navy for a naval station, with the Secretary of the Navy to take steps to establish authority and protect the islands. Identity matches EO 10264 recital ('Executive Order No. 125-A of February 19, 1900') and the Wikisource/OFR leads. I read the full held FR text of EO 10264 (hash a6e19827...): sec. 5 states 'The said Executive order of February 19, 1900, is revoked, effective July 1, 1951', unqualified, and sec. 1 transfers administration from Navy to Interior effective July 1, 1951, so the whole sole command (Navy control) is replaced; no partial-scope or savings language; no earlier ending found in held sources (cruden search hits only EO 10264 and its FR index entry '125-A (revoked by EO 10264)'). The order is not a one-time performed command; the end rests on the express revocation, not on the 1989 snapshot ('Revokedby EO 10264') or OFR editorial 'Revokes' field, which are only corroborating leads. The best supported effective end is 1951-07-01 (signing 1951-06-29 is not the effective date); this is stated here, not entered as an interval. Recommendation is NO, but approved stays false because the text of EO 125-A is not an acceptable original and the page was not inspected.
